thread:
maria_sales: FjordBank RFP follow-up. They want SSO (SAML SP/IdP), SCIM with delta + bulk import, group->role mapping (Okta), delegated admin for HR, domain proofing across bank subdomains. Procurement needs a short buyer blurb, security note, and pricing approach for predictable monthlies.

oleg_ps: Product quick: SCIM 2.0, supports delta sync and one-time CSV/JSON bulk import. We flatten nested groups by default but can include ancestry metadata if they request it. Hosted default rate is 200 req/s; Dedicated reserves throughput and workers for predictable latency. For a 2k/week ramp, suggest Dedicated or Hosted + temporary higher SCIM quota.

maria_sales: they want explicit confirmation that passwords/SSNs are not stored and whether optional PII can be omitted.

sam_security: Confirmed: we never store passwords in plaintext. Provisioning stores identifiers and attributes (email, externalId, groups) encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and in transit (TLS1.2+). Optional PII can be redacted on request. Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS/HSM and full audit logs.

toni_se: Tech snippet you can paste to buyer: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (SP/IdP), SCIM 2.0 with delta and bulk import, Okta group->role mappings (flattened by default), delegated admin workflows, and domain proofing via DNS TXT or email. For large onboarding windows we recommend Dedicated (reserved throughput) or Hosted with a provisioning quota add-on."

maria_sales: Billing Q: do we charge per-provisioned-user or per-sync-requests? They want a predictable monthly.

oleg_ps: Pricing model: base provisioning tier (covers up to N active users) + per-active-user bands. Large ramps can include a temporary reserved-throughput add-on (one-time or monthly). For ~18k employees they'd fall in our 10k-25k band; include a ramp add-on for the first 2-3 weeks. I'll loop in pricing for exact numbers.

maria_sales: Nested groups edgecases? They use heavy nesting and transforms in Okta.

toni_se: We flatten by default to simplify RBAC. If they need hierarchical roles we can pass ancestry metadata (includeNested flag) but recommend sample SCIM export to validate cycles and scale. Also note cycles can inflate payloads.

sam_security: Procurement security blurb: "SCIM provisioning data encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and in transit (TLS1.2+). No plaintext passwords or SSNs stored. Support for customer-managed KMS/HSM for Private/Dedicated. Provisioning events are logged and available for audit. We can complete vendor security questionnaire and support SOC2 evidence sharing under NDA."

maria_sales: Great. Any operational asks before I send to buyer?

oleg_ps: Ask for: (1) sample SCIM export, (2) expected ramp schedule (daily counts), (3) whether they need SCIM webhooks (we require IP whitelist/proxy), (4) DNS access details for domain proofing or contact for email-based verification.

toni_se: Quick YAML snippet for tech sheet:

```
provisioning:
  protocol: "SCIM 2.0"
  bulk_import: true
  delta_sync: true
  unique_key: "externalId | userName"
  group_mapping: "idp.group -> app.role (flattened by default)"
  hosted_rate: "200req/s (burst)"
  dedicated: "reserved throughput + SLA option"
security:
  transport: "TLS1.2+"
  at_rest: "AES-256-GCM"
  kms: "customer-managed optional"
```

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll draft the email with the purchaser and security blurbs, attach their questionnaire, and request the sample export. Sam, please start the security questionnaire and flag anything blocker-y.

sam_security: On it. Main potential blocker: if they mandate on-prem HSM with air-gapped key exchange -> moves to Private and needs infra planning. Otherwise looks straightforward. Expect first pass in 24h. :thumbsup:
